youtube.title: Why Ketchup Won't Come Out, Then Floods 🍅 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Ketchup is a shear-thinning fluid with a yield stress. At rest, tangled tomato fibers and particles form a loose network that behaves like a solid. A hard smack or shake breaks that network, and the ketchup suddenly flows like a liquid, which is why it stays stuck and then floods the plate.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
